mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM vi_driver_profile WHERE id=#{driverId}
SELECT driver_id,decision FROM vi_qualification_review WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT profile.id FROM vi_driver_profile profile JOIN vi_qualification_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.id=profile.effective_snapshot_id AND snapshot.driver_id=profile.id AND snapshot.qualification_revision=profile.qualification_revision WHERE profile.qualification_status='APPROVED' AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM vi_outbox event WHERE event.event_key=CONCAT('QUALIFICATION_EXPIRY:',snapshot.id) ) ORDER BY snapshot.expires_at,profile.id LIMIT 200
